question: Please tell me a bittersweet episode from the time when Frederica called Clind onii-sama!
answer: When Frederica was little, Clind treated her as importantly as a princess, so from how to treat a lady to the mindset of a servant, she learned it all from Clind. She declared that, in the future, she would become a maid that Clind wouldn't be ashamed of, but Clind replied "The future, is it. Hopes and fears.", already lamenting the future.
